market.title: Provider market
market.intro: Discover third-party connections and add the ones you choose.
market.signIn: Sign in to publish or manage your Providers.
market.independentPrices: All prices are optional; 0 means free. Enter each tier independently; prices are never multiplied automatically.
market.publicNotice: Published content and page access settings are visible to everyone. Do not include private keys, passwords, cookies or other login credentials.
market.name: Provider name
market.unavailable: The market is unavailable. Try again later; the server may need an update.
market.conflict: This entry has changed. Reload before editing again.
market.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage this entry.
market.invalid: Check the URL, models and prices. Models and multipliers must be unique; prices must be non-negative. Long-context prices require a threshold.
market.missing: This entry is unavailable, or the server does not support the market yet.
market.added: Added without activating. You can edit it in your Providers.
market.addInfo: Review the models and use your own API key. Adding creates a separate configuration without changing existing Providers or applying later market updates.
market.statsNotice: Usage counts distinct accounts with a successfully added, cloud-synced Provider. Anonymous or unsynced local additions are excluded. Manual order takes priority, followed by usage.
market.adminIntro: Maintain platform presets and the order of market Providers. Lower numbers appear first; leave blank to sort by usage. Model, tier and personal-list order stay unchanged.
market.deleteConfirm: Delete this publication? Configurations already added to personal lists will remain.
market.pricesNote: Prices are supplied by the publisher for reference. The Provider determines actual charges.
market.officialNote: “Maintained by Remote AI” identifies platform-maintained presets, not certification by model vendors.
market.webAddInfo: This configuration will be saved to your cloud Providers and available after computer sync. It will not activate automatically.
market.webAnonymousInfo: Without signing in, download the connection settings without a key and add them on your computer. Sign in to save directly to the cloud.
market.scriptScope: The script only parses a balance response and returns an amount and currency. Queries run on your computer over same-origin HTTPS; files, system commands and other websites are inaccessible.
market.enableScript: I reviewed the script and URL and agree to enable balance queries
market.scriptInvalid: Invalid balance script settings. Check the URL and script length.
market.scriptFailed: The balance script failed or exceeded its execution limits.
market.scriptResponse: The balance script must return a valid amount and supported currency.
market.scriptRequest: Balance query failed. Check the URL and your own key.
market.downloaded: Connection settings downloaded without a key. Import them on your computer, enter your own key and confirm adding.
market.permissionReadDescription: View public and unpublished Provider entries.
market.permissionManageDescription: Publish, edit and remove platform-maintained Providers.
market.permissionOrderDescription: Set or clear the display priority of Provider entries.
market.pageHint: These parameters and headers are sent when opening the page. Published settings are public; do not include private keys or passwords.
market.pageRequired: Enter a valid page URL and check the query string and headers.
market.browserBlank: Enter a URL in the address bar or open a page from your Providers.
market.browserInvalidUrl: Enter a complete http:// or https:// URL.
market.browserFailed: This page could not be opened. Please try again.
market.browserHeadersDesktop: This page needs custom request headers. Open it in the Windows desktop app.
market.browserHeadersUnsupported: Opening pages with custom headers is not supported on this platform yet. Use the Windows desktop app.
market.browserWebNotice: Embedding depends on the website settings. Back and Forward apply to pages opened from the address bar.
